name: branding-construction-grid-of-p-i-l-o-wordmark-on-electric-lime
title: Rounded 'pilo' wordmark shown as darker lime shapes on electric lime with grid guides and dotted circles
whatItIs: An electric lime board with a thin outlined pill 'Design Process', a grid of faint guide lines with hatched rectangles, and a wordmark 'pilo' in darker lime made of rounded strokes and circles with dotted construction circles at the ends and a dot in the p.
whatItMeans: Precise and playful; tone-on-tone shows the wordmark's geometry.
techniques: Overlay grid guides and dotted circles.
Build letters from circles and pill strokes.
